{{Current events|year=2018|month=11|day=14|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Anglophone Crisis]]
**The [[Cameroonian Armed Forces]] kill at least 30 [[Ambazonia]]n separatists in two-days of intense clashes in [[Cameroon]]'s English-speaking region. A mayor in [[Donga-Mantung]] is also shot dead. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/11/dozens-anglophone-separatists-killed-cameroon-181114123105360.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 California wildfires]]
**The death toll in the [[Camp Fire (2018)|Camp Fire]] rises to 56, with the statewide total at 59. Authorities release the names of 130 people who are missing, including many in their 80s and 90s, with the potential that dozens more are unaccounted for. [https://www.cbsnews.com/live-news/california-fires-camp-woolsey-containment-evacuations-death-toll-2018-11-14-live-updates/ (CBS News)]
*A [[hot air balloon]] filled with [[fireworks]] and other [[pyrotechnics]] explodes midair during [[Tazaungdaing festival]] celebrations in [[Taunggyi]], [[Myanmar]], injuring nine people on the ground. [https://abc13.com/hot-air-balloon-full-of-fireworks-explodes-over-festival/4707979/ (ABC News)]

;International relations
*[[Brexit negotiations]]
**[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|British Prime Minister]] [[Theresa May]] wins approval of her [[Brexit]] plan from her [[Cabinet of the United Kingdom|cabinet]], although many [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative]] and opposition MPs voice strong disapproval. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2018/nov/14/theresa-may-wins-cabinet-backing-for-brexit-deal (The Guardian)] [https://www.politicshome.com/news/uk/political-parties/conservative-party/theresa-may/news/99858/cabinet-backs-theresa-may-brexit (Politics Home)]
*The [[United Nations Security Council]] unanimously votes to lift sanctions on [[Eritrea]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-46193273 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[2018 California wildfires]]
**A lawsuit is filed against [[Pacific Gas and Electric Company]], alleging company negligence and health and safety code violations in the [[Camp Fire (2018)|Camp Fire]], which has killed at least 48 people. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-california-wildfires-lawsuit-idUSKCN1NJ20G (Reuters)] [http://www.latimes.com/local/california/la-me-paradise-fire-lawsuit-1542165733-htmlstory.html (''Los Angeles Times'')]
*[[Persecution of Muslims in Myanmar]], [[Inn Din massacre]]
**[[Vice President of the United States|U.S. Vice President]] [[Mike Pence]] condemns [[Myanmar]]'s treatment of [[Rohingya people|Rohingya]] Muslims and called for [[Aung San Suu Kyi]] to pardon Wa Lone and Kyaw Soe Oo, the two [[Reuters]] journalists [[Inn Din massacre#Arrest of Reuters journalists|imprisoned]] in the country. [https://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/mike-pence-aung-san-suu-kyi-reuters-reporters_us_5bebd6e6e4b0caeec2bf6cbe (Huffington Post)]
*[[Tampon tax]]
**The [[Constitutional Court of Colombia]] unanimously rules to strike down a five per cent tax on [[feminine hygiene]] products on [[gender equality]] grounds. [https://www.eltiempo.com/justicia/cortes/corte-constitucional-tumba-iva-a-toallas-higienicas-y-tampones-293498 (El Tiempo)]  

;Politics and elections
*[[2018 Sri Lankan constitutional crisis]]
**The [[15th Parliament of Sri Lanka|Sri Lankan Parliament]] reconvenes. The [[Speaker of the Parliament of Sri Lanka|Speaker]] says it passed a [[motion of no confidence]] against the disputed [[Prime Minister of Sri Lanka|Prime Minister]] [[Mahinda Rajapaksa]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/11/sri-lanka-parliament-votes-newly-appointed-pm-rajapaksa-181114052753680.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Cabinet of Israel]]
**[[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|Defence Minister]] [[Avigdor Lieberman]] announces his resignation with effect in 48 hours in response to the [[Egypt]]ian-mediated ceasefire between [[Israel]] and [[Hamas]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/11/israel-defence-minister-lieberman-resigns-gaza-ceasefire-181114111137338.html (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-46207094 (BBC)]
*[[White House Press Secretary]] [[Sarah Huckabee Sanders]] says [[Deputy National Security Advisor (United States)|Deputy National Security Advisor]] [[Mira Ricardel]] is "to transition to a new role within the administration", a day after [[First Lady of the United States|First Lady]] [[Melania Trump]] called for Ricardel's ousting. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-ricardel/trump-aide-ricardel-forced-out-after-showdown-with-first-lady-idUSKCN1NJ37Z (Reuters)]

;Science and technology
*Astronomers announce, through the journal [[Nature (journal)|''Nature'']], the discovery of [[Barnard's Star b]], a [[Super-Earth]] [[exoplanet]] orbiting [[Barnard's Star]], the fourth-nearest-known individual star to the [[Sun]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-46196279 (BBC)]
